note: Live CMS edits of 29 Oct 2026 aligning country guides with the owner's local-currency decision. To roll back, swap old and new, guarded by version+1.

edits.old: AUD quotes should be confirmed, not converted automatically
edits.new: AUD prices: a guide first, then a confirmed quote

edits.old: If no AUD amount is approved, request a written quote before enrolling. We do not turn a USD price into an AUD fee using an assumed exchange rate.
edits.new: If no AUD amount is approved, the site shows an approximate AUD figure converted from the US dollar price at today’s exchange rate. Treat it as a guide and request a written quote before enrolling; the converted figure is not itself the college’s fee.
CAD prices: a guide first, then a confirmed quote

edits.old: If no CAD amount is shown, request a written quote before enrolling. We do not turn a USD price into a CAD fee with an assumed exchange rate.
edits.new: If no approved CAD amount exists, the site shows an approximate CAD figure converted from the US dollar price at today’s exchange rate. Treat it as a guide and request a written quote before enrolling; the converted figure is not itself the college’s fee.
